notes: Sheet drawn with north to the left: Cormany along the top, Bates Alley and Bates Av. running down the left part, Stock down the right, Colerain across the bottom. Names printed 'CORMANY AV.', 'BATES ALLEY', 'BATES AV.', 'MASSACHUSETTS AV.', 'SIDNEY AV.', 'HENSHAW AV.', 'STOCK AV.', 'COLERAIN AV.', 'ETHAN AV.'. Bates Alley's west line is the edge of the drawn blocks (sheets 294/295 beyond); Cormany, Henshaw and Colerain stop at it (T). Massachusetts and Sidney start at Bates Av. (T). Henshaw meets Stock twice: the Henshaw Av. stub east of Stock (58', sheet 288's Henshaw) at y ~3100, just north of Sidney, and the Henshaw Av. on this sheet (50', from Bates Alley ENE) at y ~4886, much further south. South of Sidney Stock pinches to nothing at (4692,3995) and continues as a 10' lane that widens to 27' at Colerain; the T points with Stock use the centre of that lane. Colerain's south line is drawn only east of x ~3000; west of that its centre is taken 30 ft (~185 px, scale 100 ft = ~608 px) south of the north building line, so the Colerain/Bates Av. and especially Colerain/Bates Alley points (the latter only ~20 px above the paper edge) are derived from the printed 60' width. Ethan Av. (about 38 ft, no width printed) comes into Colerain from the south (sheet 279 side). The unnamed 10' N-S alley at x ~2920-2980 crosses Cormany, Massachusetts, Sidney and Henshaw (recorded as crossings) and has E-W branches to Stock in each block.
